info.name: Endpoints subpackage_ats API
subpackage_ats
Add note to an application

params.name: application_id
params.description: Id of the application which the note will be added

items.docs:
Create application note: Adds a new note to a specific candidate application. Use this to record interview feedback, recruiter observations, or internal comments during the hiring process. The 'authorId' must correspond to a valid HRIS user. Scope: ats:write
 **Token scopes**: `ats:write`

info.name: Associate application with an interview plan stage

params.name: application_id
params.description: ID of the application to be associated with the interview plan stage

items.docs: Use this endpoint to associate an application with a specific interview plan stage in the hiring workflow. Use it when moving a candidate into a stage or backfilling history. Set is_current_stage to true to update the application's current stage; set it to false to record a historical entry without changing the current stage. To control triggered activities, pass applicable_job_activities; omit it to trigger all activities or pass an empty array to trigger none. If the candidate is being archive

info.name: Retrieve a list of ATS applications

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the nextCursor value from the previous response to get the next page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of applications to return per page

params.name: search_text
params.description: Search text to filter applications by candidate name or email

params.name: job_id
params.description: Filter applications by specific job ID

params.name: interview_plan_stage_ids
params.description: Filter applications by specific interview plan stage IDs

params.name: candidate_tag_ids
params.description: Filter applications by candidate tag IDs

params.name: source_slugs
params.description: Filter applications by source slugs

params.name: job_criterias_matchings
params.description: Filter applications by job criteria matching state. Each object specifies a job criteria ID and whether the candidate matches it.

params.name: current_stage_category_type_slugs
params.description: Filter applications by current stage category type slugs

params.name: current_stage_default_type_slugs
params.description: Filter applications by current stage default type slugs. Use 'others' for custom stages.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Filter applications updated after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort applications by

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for applications

items.docs:
List applications: Returns a paginated list of candidate applications for an organization. Use this to track and review the progress of candidates across all open positions. Supports cursor-based pagination and filtering via query parameters. Scope: ats:read
 **Token scopes**: `ats:read`

info.name: Create ATS Application

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to create a new application linking an existing candidate to a job in your ATS. Call it when a candidate applies or when importing applications from another system.

info.name: Create candidate tags

params.name: candidate_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the candidate.

items.docs:
This endpoint replaces all existing tags associated with a candidate with a new set. Use this when updating candidate tags is necessary.
 **Token scopes**: `ats:write`

info.name: List tags

params.name: search_text
params.description: Filter tags by label (case-insensitive partial match)

params.name: tag_group_slug
params.description: Filter by tag group. Use CANDIDATE for candidate tags.

params.name: include_counts
params.description: When true, each tag includes candidates_count (number of candidates with that tag)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor for pagination. Use the value from next_cursor of the previous response to fetch the next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of tags to return per page (default: 20, max: 100).

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to list all tags associated with the organization. View or organize tags based on filters like label or tag group.
 **Token scopes**: `ats:read`

List email templates: Returns a paginated list of published email templates for an organization. Use this to populate template selectors when composing candidate communications or automating outreach workflows. Supports cursor-based pagination and filtering by update time via the 'updatedAfter' query parameter. Scope: ats:read
 **Token scopes**: `ats:read`

info.name: Retrieve ATS application

params.name: application_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the application to retrieve

items.docs:
This endpoint retrieves a single application by its ID for a specific organization. It provides detailed information about the application, including its associated job details, job posting details, and other relevant metadata.
 **Token scopes**: `ats:read`

info.name: Retrieve ATS hiring members

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor for pagination

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records returned in one response

items.docs:
This endpoint retrieves a list of ATS hiring members. It provides detailed information about each hiring member, including their unique identifier, name, job title, email, profile picture URL, etc. The response also includes pagination details to help navigate through large sets of hiring members.
 **Token scopes**: `ats:read`
